description: EXP-23. Trusted-domain narrow-then-widen retrieval (SRCH-5/6/7) is the production default and has never been measured. The principal suspect for the 80% false-positive rate on NL negative golds is that narrowing guarantees every search returns portal-adjacent pages, which the Researcher then over-reads as positive evidence on questions whose true answer is 'no'. Three arms hold one variable (retrieval strategy): baseline_narrow_then_wide (production), wide_only (never narrow), narrow_only (always narrow, never widen so any wide_only gain is attributable to the widening step and not to the absence of narrowing). One experiment block per country so the class-balanced pair file matches the country's gold distribution. Dispatch waits for explicit go from Benjy; the design is locked when this spec is committed.
pre_flight_checks: Trusted-domain registries: data/trusted_domains/NL.json exists and is non-empty (verified). data/trusted_domains/MT.json and data/trusted_domains/AL.json do NOT exist - they must be authored before the narrow_only and baseline_narrow_then_wide arms can produce a meaningful narrow pass on those countries. Without them, both arms collapse to wide_only on MT and AL and the experiment cannot test the hypothesis there.

Pair file: data/questions/al_eval_pairs.json does NOT exist. Generate using the same selection_rule as nl_eval_pairs.json and malta_eval_pairs.json: all AL binary `no`-gold questions plus a dimension-stratified size-matched sample of `yes`-gold questions, RNG seed 20260603.

Manipulation check: narrow_only and baseline_narrow_then_wide must show identical narrow-stage queries on pairs where narrow returned non-empty; the only divergence is the widening step. Confirm by diffing search_provider_calls across the two arms on a 5-pair smoke before reading endpoints.

Manipulation check: wide_only must issue 0 site-restricted queries on every pair (the search_start event payload's `trusted_domains` may still list them, but search_many must be called with include_domains=None). Confirm by inspecting walkthrough output on a 5-pair smoke.
Held-out countries (BA MK ME BG FI HR SE BE) must not appear in any arm. Confirmed: only NL, MT, AL.

endpoints.primary: False-positive rate on negative golds in the binary-commit subset, pooled and per country, Wilson CI.
endpoints.co_primary: Commit accuracy on the binary-commit subset, pooled and per country.
secondary: Candidate recall (gold in any Researcher attempt)
Fetched-page novelty (unique URLs reached across arms - confirms wide_only actually finds different evidence)
endpoints.diagnostic: Among the false positives in each arm, count how many cite a trusted-domain page vs a non-trusted one. Direct test of the over-trust hypothesis.
endpoints.stratification: ODMI dimension (Policy / Portal / Quality / Impact) and country.

inference_rules: If wide_only cuts negative-gold FP by >= 5 absolute points AND commit accuracy non-inferior (delta accuracy >= -0.02) on NL, narrow-then-widen is implicated as a FP cause. Promote wide_only to production default.
If wide_only's FP drop is concentrated in cases where the baseline FP source URL was a trusted-domain page, the over-trust mechanism is confirmed specifically.
If wide_only raises candidate recall on AL by >= 5 absolute points, narrow-first was also suppressing recall on thin-web. Independent second finding.
If neither holds (FP within +/- 2 points, recall within +/- 2 points), keep narrow_then_wide. Production default survives the test; SRCH-5/6 marked measured-and-defensible.
narrow_only is a control for attribution. Not adopted under any rule.
